experiment_name: Update-budget sweep: 100/500/1000 updates, same baseline + same replay, zero new games

algorithm_config.each_budget_starts_fresh_from: 013's pre-training baseline checkpoint (never resumes from another budget's checkpoint)
algorithm_config.single_variable: update budget only - same baseline, same replay buffer, same sampling seed each run, so the first 100 updates are byte-identical across all three runs and the first 500 identical between the 500- and 1000-update runs (verified: interval_log entries at update 25/50/75/100 are bit-identical across all three, and at 125-500 identical between the 500 and 1000 runs)

metrics.trend: total loss decreases monotonically at the sampled checkpoints (100: 2.469, 500: 1.971, 1000: 1.648). value_loss drops sharply and close to monotonically (0.810 -> 0.314 -> 0.108) - consistent with the value head increasingly fitting the fixed 37,772-position replay buffer, which raises an overfitting concern since no new data is introduced between budgets. policy_loss is noisier and shows much less improvement (1.658 -> 1.657 -> 1.541) - it does not track value_loss's clean downward trend over the same fixed dataset.

loss.note: full per-25-update interval log (4/20/40 entries for the 100/500/1000 budgets respectively) is in the raw stdout, not duplicated here in full - see metrics.trend for the summary and raw_logs for every value

result: All three budgets (100/500/1000 updates) completed with every update producing a finite loss - no divergence, no stop condition triggered. Zero new self-play games generated (reused 013's 37,772-position replay buffer and pre-training baseline checkpoint, both integrity-checked before any training started). asu_modules_loaded count 0 for all three. Total wall time for all three budgets combined: 12.98s (no new game generation is why this is dramatically faster than 013's 301.55s). Whether more updates on this same fixed dataset produce a measurably stronger policy - as opposed to just fitting the value head to the same 32 games' outcomes - is evaluated separately in 016-monopolyzero-update-budget-sweep-paired-eval.json, not claimed here.
notes: Checkpoints (trained_updates_{100,500,1000}.pt) are not committed, per CLAUDE.md - referenced by SHA-256 and local path only. integrity.illegal_actions/fallbacks/crashes are 0/0/0 because this run plays no games at all (pure replay-buffer training), unlike 013.
